acceptance: No create-github-app-token step uses app-id in either repository, and the deprecation warning is gone from their runs.
theseus infra setup delivers the review App client ID, and a re-run plans no change.
A review run, a gate run and a SQLGlot delivery run succeed after the switch.
description: actions/create-github-app-token warns that the `app-id` input is deprecated in favor of `client-id`. Current uses: Theseus .github/workflows/gate.yml (two steps) and review.yml (two steps), which read secrets.REVIEW_APP_ID; BenchBox .github/workflows/site-inputs.yml (SITE_BRIDGE_APP_ID) and sqlglot-delivery.yml (two steps, SQLGLOT_DELIVERY_APP_ID). Each App's client ID must be stored (secret or variable) before switching, and `theseus infra setup` should deliver the review App's client ID the same way it delivers REVIEW_APP_ID today. Changes to the review workflows are soundness paths and follow the review gate rules.
